text:
Which statement about the uses of metals is correct?
A
Aluminium is used in the manufacture of overhead electrical cables as it has a high density.
B
Aluminium is used to make food containers as it conducts electricity.
C
Stainless steel is used in cutlery because it is resistant to rusting.
D
Stainless steel is used to make chemical reactors because it is a soft alloy.

options.label: A
options.text: Aluminium is used in the manufacture of overhead electrical cables as it has a high density.

options.label: B
options.text: Aluminium is used to make food containers as it conducts electricity.

options.label: C
options.text: Stainless steel is used in cutlery because it is resistant to rusting.

options.label: D
options.text: Stainless steel is used to make chemical reactors because it is a soft alloy.
